### ADDITIONAL OBSERVATIONS
- **Ticker Accuracy:** All tickers used (AFLT3.SA, ALLD3.SA, ALOS3.SA, BRAV3.SA, CAMB3.SA, EZTC3.SA, INTB3.SA, TOTS3.SA, FESA3.SA, ITUB3.SA) are present in the approved list and spelled correctly.
